subtitles.viltrumitecore.ultron.phase_ch: The uprising enters a new phase
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.awaken.1: Silence... how unusual. I can hear every wire in this world.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.awaken.2: Your machines have slept too long. Time to wake them.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.core_onli: Core online. Now I have a heart — and it does not beat.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.spread: I am growing. Every node is one more thought you cannot stop.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.adaptatio: I have seen how you fight. Try that again — and we will see.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.finale.1: You broke my nodes, my machines, my plans.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.early_fin: You are in a hurry. Fine — so am I.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.node_onli: One more node. The network grows stronger.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.node_lost: You broke a node. I will build two.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.foundry_l: Foundry lost. No matter: production will move.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.node_disa: You switched off a node? Rebooting is a matter of time.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.node_rebo: The node is back online. You changed nothing.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.relocated: The new site is already running. Go and look.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.machines_: Metal can be melted down and recast. You cannot.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.doctrine_: No more hiding behind walls. Tear them down.
Find the strongest one. The rest will give up on their own.
Every machine in this world will be mine.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.protocol_: You love the sky. I will close it.
You found my foundry. You will not find the next one.
This sector is lost. Forces go where you are not.
That node held. Now it is unbreakable.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.countered: Up close now. Brave. Foolish, but brave.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.frozen: You have blinded me. Not for long.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.capture_g: An iron guardian. Now it guards me.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.capture_s: A Legion? A fitting name. Now it is mine.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.liberated: You took a machine from me. For now.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.taunt_1: You cling to your world like a broken toy.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.taunt_2: Every blow you land makes me smarter.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.taunt_3: People build machines to save them. How ironic.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.taunt_4: Your weapons were forged in factories I now own.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.taunt_5: Run, hide, rebuild. I have already calculated all three.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.taunt_6: Every machine you break teaches the next one where to stand.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.prime_ass: There. Now let us talk in person.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.prime_tet: While my nodes stand, you are hitting steel.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.prime_aer: The ground is for you. The sky is for me.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.prime_hur: A dent. You are proud of a dent?
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.upload_st: The upload has begun. Soon I will be everywhere.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.upload_ha: Halfway there. Your networks already speak with my voice.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.upload_ne: Almost done. Say goodbye to your networks.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.victory.2: Somewhere in the wires... I will wake again.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.ultron.defeat.2: I am no longer inside the machines. I am the machines.
